user.title: Connect seven.io
user.description: Create an API key in the seven.io dashboard (Developer → API keys). It needs access to balance, RCS and webhooks; sending will additionally need SMS, RCS and voice. Using a subaccount keeps business and private messages apart.

data_description.api_key: Checked right away against the balance and the RCS agent list.

settings.title: Sending and signing
settings.description: Agents in test mode reach only the test numbers you unlocked for them in the seven.io dashboard — that is fine for permanent use.

data_description.rcs_agent: Sender for RCS messages. Status in brackets: test, pending or launched (generic seven agents: wait, approved or denied).
data_description.sms_sender: Up to 11 letters/digits or up to 16 digits. Empty = seven.io default.
data_description.signing_secret: From the seven.io dashboard (Developer → API settings). With it, every incoming webhook is checked for a valid signature. Strongly recommended as soon as messages trigger automations.

webhook.title: Incoming messages
webhook.description: How should seven.io reach Home Assistant for incoming RCS messages and status reports? The integration registers its own webhooks with seven.io and only ever removes those; existing webhooks in the account stay untouched.

nabu_casa.title: Nabu Casa
nabu_casa.description: Home Assistant Cloud creates a public hooks.nabu.casa address for this integration.

data_description.event_types: RCS covers incoming RCS messages, button replies, locations, files and read/delivery status. Incoming SMS needs an inbound number at seven.io.

custom_url.title: Own URL
custom_url.description: Public HTTPS base address of this Home Assistant instance, e.g. https://ha.example.com. The integration appends /api/webhook/ plus a random ID.

data_description.base_url: Must be reachable from the internet via HTTPS.
data_description.event_types: RCS covers incoming RCS messages, button replies, locations, files and read/delivery status. Incoming SMS needs an inbound number at seven.io.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: seven.io rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: seven.io rejected the API key (wrong key or missing permissions).
error.cloud_not_connected: Home Assistant Cloud is not connected right now.
error.cloud_no_subscription: No active Home Assistant Cloud subscription.
error.no_event_types: Choose at least one webhook type.
error.url_not_https: The URL must start with https://.
error.sender_invalid: Up to 11 letters/digits or up to 16 digits.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

agent_missing.title: RCS agent not found
agent_missing.description: seven.io no longer lists the RCS agent {agent}. Choose another agent in the integration options.

agent_denied.title: RCS agent denied
agent_denied.description: seven.io denied the use of the RCS agent {agent}. RCS messages via this agent will fail.
